risk_score.normalizers: fit only on development/calibration; frozen before test
risk_score.aggregation: predeclared weighted sum or vector-valued score; units recorded

tail_metrics.worst5: top ceil(0.05*N) errors with deterministic fractional boundary
tail_metrics.cvar95: same empirical upper-tail integral including fractional boundary mass
tail_metrics.empty_tail: forbidden; exact finite-sample rule must always return a number

inference.n5_claim: descriptive/pilot only unless power and exact paired test preregistered
inference.effect_threshold: freeze practical minimum effect before test
